## v1.36.0

GenUI widgets now render the nested, multi-line content the agent sends. Nothing is removed, but a few renderer outputs change shape (see Behavior change), so check hosts that read descriptors directly. Tool configs now survive a read and re-save, and an OAuth2 `client_secret` is saved in the form that resolves. Some tool inputs are now rejected before any network call. Tools saved earlier with the bare `secrets.NAME` client secret must be re-saved.

### Added

- `video-gallery` reads `citation.clips` and `clips`. Each video has `startTime` and `endTime` in seconds (`null` when absent), and `video_link` works as a url alias. (#399)
- `flashcards` reads `keypoints` (title is the front, summary is the back) and keeps each card's clips as `card.clips`. (#399)
- `content-gallery` items have `type` and `clips`. A video slide gets a play button and the first clip fills `imageUrl` and `url`. (#399)
- `sources` keep `entryId`, `type`, `duration` and `hasShort` when the widget sends them. (#399)
- `summary` has `chapters`, a list of strings shown as an ordered list by `mountWidget`. (#399)
- `video-tool` (and `video`) render as `external-video`. `GENUI_RUNTIMES` is unchanged. (#399)
- The `play` action payload has `startTime` and `endTime`. (#399)
- `tools.client` takes `responseMapping`, `responseTemplate`, `responseChapters` (at most one) and `variablesMapping`, with the same rules as `tools.api`.
- `tools.api` takes `waitForResponse`.
- `intellectConfig.audit` and `doctor` warn `tool_name_builtin` when a linked tool has the same name as a built-in tool.

### Fixed

- `parseContent` reads nested lists, `|` and `>` block scalars, multi-line and escaped quoted strings and flow `[]` and `{}`, so keypoints, slides and clips no longer fall into `.raw`. (#399)
- `tools.update(id, { config })` with a config read from `tools.get` keeps `wait_for_response` on api tools and the response fields on client tools.
- Response paths accept a hyphen in a segment, such as `headers.X-Request-Id`.

### Behavior change

- `content-gallery` descriptions keep their line breaks. `mountWidget` shows them as spaces. (#399)
- `content-gallery` drops items that have no id, title, text, image, link or clips. (#399)
- `parseContent` no longer reads `key:value` (no space after the colon) as a key. It goes to `.raw`. (#399)
- The `summary` descriptor always has `chapters` (an empty list when none). (#399)
- A renderer registered as `video` now replaces the `external-video` renderer, because `video` is an alias. (#399)
- `onAgentAction` sees `runtime: 'external-video'` for a `video-tool` widget. (#399)
- `tools.api` saves an OAuth2 `client_secret` as `{{secrets.NAME}}`. The bare `secrets.NAME` input still works. A tool saved earlier with the bare form sends the reference text, not the secret. Re-save it: `const t = await mgmt.tools.get(id, ks); await mgmt.tools.update(id, { config: t.config }, ks);`
- `provision()` lists a tool that an intellect uses in `skippedUpdates` and does not re-save it, so run the re-save line above for those tools.
- `responseChapters` needs `iterate_on`, `content` and `link`, each a dot-path. A `{field}` template there is rejected.
- `tools.update` checks a new `name` with the same rule as `add`.
- `tools.var` rejects arg names that start with `secrets`.
- `request.headers` values must be strings.

### Docs and skill

- The GenUI widget reference lists the new fields and a shared clip table. (#399)
- Tools and Secrets: URL rules at run time, the builder's timeout and url checks, and the `{{secrets.NAME}}` syntax everywhere.
- `intellectConfig.audit` is the check for secret references in linked tools.
